---
title: "09_analysis_5"
format: html
---

Load libraries
```{r}
library("tidyverse")
library("broom")
```

Read cleaned and augmented dataset
```{r}
clean_data <- read_tsv(
  file = "../data/03_dat_aug.tsv",
  show_col_types = FALSE)
```

Preper predictors: Set reference levels for categorical predictors, applies log1p() to infarct volume (volinf) to handle right skew and zeros, and drops rows with missing values in the model variables.
```{r}
adj_data <- clean_data |>
  mutate(
    smoker_group = factor(
      if_else(smoker == "never", "Never smoked", "Smoked"),
      levels = c("Never smoked", "Smoked")),
    chf = factor(chf, levels = c(0, 1), labels = c("No CHF", "CHF")),
    diabetes = factor(diabetes, levels = c(0, 1), labels = c("No diabetes", "Diabetes")),
    stroke_event = factor(
      if_else(stroke == 2, 1, 0),
      levels = c(0, 1),
      labels = c("No stroke", "Prior stroke")),
    sex = factor(sex, levels = c("Female", "Male")),
    log_volinf = log1p(volinf)
  ) |>
  drop_na(
    death, age, sex, chf, diabetes, smoker_group,
    stroke_event, dsst, aai, log_volinf)
```

Fit logistic regression: Models the binary outcome death using multiple 
predictors at once (glm with a binomial family) and converts the results into 
odds ratios with 95% confidence intervals to measure each variable's independent 
link to mortality.
```{r}
adj_model <- glm(
  formula = death ~ age + sex + chf + diabetes + smoker_group +
    stroke_event + dsst + aai + log_volinf,
  data = adj_data,
  family = binomial())

adj_results <- tidy(
  x = adj_model,
  exponentiate = TRUE,
  conf.int = TRUE)

adj_results
```

Plot odds ratios: Plots the adjusted odds ratios and their 95% confidence 
intervals against a reference line at 1, colored by statistical significance.
```{r}
or_plot <- adj_results |>
  filter(term != "(Intercept)") |>
  mutate(
    significant = if_else(p.value < 0.05, "p < 0.05", "p >= 0.05"),
    term = fct_reorder(.f = term, .x = estimate)
  ) |>
  ggplot(aes(
    x = estimate,
    y = term,
    colour = significant
  )) +
  geom_vline(
    xintercept = 1,
    linetype = "dashed"
  ) +
  geom_errorbarh(
    aes(
      xmin = conf.low,
      xmax = conf.high),
    height = 0.2
  ) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  labs(
    title = "Adjusted odds ratios for mortality",
    x = "Odds ratio",
    y = NULL,
    colour = NULL
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")

or_plot
```

Save results
```{r}
dir.create(
  path = "../results/09_analysis_5",
  showWarnings = FALSE,
  recursive = TRUE)

ggsave(
  filename = "../results/09_analysis_5/adjusted_or_plot.png",
  plot = or_plot,
  width = 9,
  height = 5.5,
  dpi = 300)
```
